chapter_seo_title: Dao-Twisted World Chapter 245: Li Huowang’s Body Horror and the Brutal Cure
chapter_meta_description: After escaping with the Black Tai Sui, Li Huowang discovers his body has been twisted by white panicles. In a grisly self-surgery, he fights to stay human.
og_description: Li Huowang got what he came for, but his own flesh no longer obeys him. One of the most brutal body-horror chapters yet.
twitter_title: After the victory comes the horror. Li Huowang’s body is no longer his own.
twitter_description: He won the Black Tai Sui. But when he looked at his own reflection, he saw a mass of misplaced flesh. Now he’s cutting himself back into shape — one scream at a time.

lore_anchors.definition: A grotesque parasitic entity produced by twisted cultivation; in folk religion, Tai Sui is a life-giving substance, but here it is an organic horror that must be eaten to survive.
Pale, swaying organic tendrils from the underground entity that can rearrange biological structure; they are the cause of Li Huowang's body-horror transformation.
